rationale: The hash-bound packet and prepared manifest are valid, and all D001–D011 dependencies resolve the target to the claim that no total real-valued right inverse of squaring exists. Read in its specified role, this is exactly the algebraic counterexample needed against the source's unrestricted raw-moment wording: p = 1/2 is positive, X may take negative real values, and footnotes 1–2 provide no convention that makes the raw half-power a real-valued integrand there.
